effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, for every 2 colors your Tamers have, their Digimon's effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
